name: en-long-01-launch-update
input: hi everyone quick update on the launch the beta went out to two hundred fifty users last tuesday and we have already collected about forty responses most people like the new onboarding flow but a few said the sign up takes too long the engineering team fixed that issue yesterday and shipped the patch this morning we still need to decide on pricing and i suggest we meet on thursday at ten thirty to go through the numbers please send me your questions before then thanks
reference: Hi everyone, quick update on the launch. The beta went out to 250 users last Tuesday, and we have already collected about 40 responses. Most people like the new onboarding flow, but a few said the sign-up takes too long. The engineering team fixed that issue yesterday and shipped the patch this morning. We still need to decide on pricing, and I suggest we meet on Thursday at 10:30 to go through the numbers. Please send me your questions before then. Thanks.
